# ===================================================================
# BAD VARIABLE EXAMPLES
# ===================================================================
# This file demonstrates INCORRECT CK3 variable usage that SHOULD FAIL validation.
# All examples in this file contain variable errors.
#
# Error Codes Demonstrated:
# - CK3701 (Warning): Variable used but never declared
# - CK3702 (Hint): Variable declared but never used
# - CK3703 (Error): Scope mismatch — local declared, global checked (or vice versa)
# - CK3705 (Warning): Variable used as both list and value
#
# Expected validation result: ERRORS DETECTED
# ===================================================================

# ERROR: CK3306
namespace = variables_bad

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# ERROR CK3701: Variable used but never declared
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Detection of variables checked but never set
# SHOULD FAIL: Yes - CK3701 warning
# WHY IT'S BAD: has_variable checks a variable that was never set_variable'd
# HOW TO FIX: Add set_variable = { name = mystery_var value = yes } before use
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
variables_bad.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = variables_bad.0001.t
	desc = variables_bad.0001.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		# No set_variable for mystery_var anywhere
	}

	option = {
		name = variables_bad.0001.a
		trigger = {
			has_variable = mystery_var # ERROR CK3701: Variable "mystery_var" used but never declared
		}
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# ERROR CK3702: Variable declared but never used
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Detection of variables set but never checked or read
# SHOULD FAIL: Yes - CK3702 hint
# WHY IT'S BAD: Dead variable — set but never read, wastes processing
# HOW TO FIX: Either use the variable or remove the set_variable call
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
variables_bad.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = variables_bad.0002.t
	desc = variables_bad.0002.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = forgotten_var # ERROR CK3702: Variable "forgotten_var" declared but never used
			value = 42
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = variables_bad.0002.a
		add_prestige = 50
		# forgotten_var is never checked or read
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# ERROR CK3703: Scope mismatch — local declared, global checked
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Detection of mismatched variable scope access
# SHOULD FAIL: Yes - CK3703 error
# WHY IT'S BAD: Variable set as local but checked as global (different scopes)
# HOW TO FIX: Use consistent scope — set_local_variable + has_local_variable
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
variables_bad.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = variables_bad.0003.t
	desc = variables_bad.0003.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		set_local_variable = {
			name = my_counter
			value = 5
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = variables_bad.0003.a
		trigger = {
			has_global_variable = my_counter # ERROR CK3703: Variable "my_counter" is local but accessed as global
		}
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variable used as both list and value
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Detection of variable type confusion
# SHOULD FAIL: Yes - CK3705 warning
# WHY IT'S BAD: Variable used as a scalar value and as a list simultaneously
# HOW TO FIX: Use separate variables for value and list
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
variables_bad.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	title = variables_bad.0004.t
	desc = variables_bad.0004.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = mixed_var
			value = 10
		}
		add_to_variable_list = {
			name = mixed_var # ERROR CK3705: Variable "mixed_var" used as both list and value
			value = root
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = variables_bad.0004.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combined: All variable errors in one event
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Multiple error types at once
# SHOULD FAIL: Yes - CK3701, CK3702, CK3703, CK3705
# DEMONSTRATES: An event with every category of variable error
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
variables_bad.0005 = {
	type = character_event
	title = variables_bad.0005.t
	desc = variables_bad.0005.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = unused_score # ERROR CK3702: Declared but never used
			value = 100
		}
		set_local_variable = {
			name = scope_confused
			value = 42
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = type_confused
			value = 5
		}
		add_to_variable_list = {
			name = type_confused # ERROR CK3705: Used as both list and value
			value = root
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = variables_bad.0005.a
		trigger = {
			has_variable = never_set_var # ERROR CK3701: Used but never declared
			has_global_variable = scope_confused # ERROR CK3703: Local variable accessed as global
		}
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Edge cases
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Subtle variable errors that are easy to miss
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
variables_bad.0006 = {
	type = character_event
	title = variables_bad.0006.t
	desc = variables_bad.0006.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		set_global_variable = {
			name = global_tracker
			value = 1
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = variables_bad.0006.a
		trigger = {
			has_local_variable = global_tracker # ERROR CK3703: Variable "global_tracker" is global but accessed as local
		}
		add_gold = 50
	}
}
